etsy.title: Debugging Poster, console.log Joke Print, JavaScript Humor Wall Art, Gift for Coders, Dark Mode Office Decor
etsy.description:
A funny debugging poster for every developer whose favorite tool is console.log('here'), in dark-mode colors.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a home office, dev den, or coding setup.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy has a framed 'print debugging' wall print and several console.log('here') shirts, so the joke has buyers but few unframed posters.
Debugging results are mostly how-to step posters and rubber-duck prints; a single one-line joke print stands apart.
Most JavaScript humor results are instant digital downloads; 'physical poster print' differentiates.
Debugging humor on Amazon is crowded with the detective/murderer quote, 'stages of debugging' and bug-free-until-run metal signs.
Amazon programmer prints lead with the joke, then stack 'wall art', 'office decor', 'developer gift' and state 'unframed' plus size.

research.notes: Picked 'debugging poster' over 'console log poster': it appears in Amazon titles and Etsy results, while no indexed console.log poster phrase was found. 'JavaScript' is named because the printed line is JavaScript code. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with framed prints, and no unframed physical prints with prices were comparable.
